navaid.name: USCGC Cheyenne
navaid.description: The USCGC Cheyenne is a 75 ft. river buoy tender that maintains buoys and other aids to navigation on the Upper Mississippi River, from Chester IL, to Alton, IL; the Missouri River to Glasgow, MO; and the Kaskaskia River New Athens, IL.

navaid.name: USCGC Gasconade
navaid.description: USCGC Gasconade is a 75' river buoy tender that maintains buoys and other aids to navigation on the Missouri River from Hamilton, IL to Sioux City, IA.

navaid.name: U.S. Coast Guard
navaid.description: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Service Base St Louis hosts U.S. Coast Guard Electronic Support Detachment St Louis and elements of U.S. Coast Guard Sector Upper Mississippi River including Boat forces and U.S. Coast Guard Cutter Cheyenne.
